title: A vous sans aultre (Busnoys)
desc: Antoine Busnoys, A vous sans aultre. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Contratenor), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Bus3008); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
